description: This PHP source file defines the 'FilterID' class, a deprecated Drupal plugin for processing filter IDs during migration, including methods for transforming filter identifiers and determining filter types.

classes.name: FilterID
classes.description: A deprecated Drupal migration process plugin class that maps filter IDs to filter plugins, handling missing plugins and providing filter type information.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the FilterID plugin with configuration, plugin ID, definition, filter manager, and optional translator.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms a filter ID value into a plugin ID, handling missing plugins, deprecated filters, and fallback logic.

methods.name: getSourceFilterType
methods.description: Determines the Drupal 8 filter type for a given Drupal 7 filter ID.
